description: This file defines the core logic of a coin toss game, including game state management, user interaction, coin flip simulation, and game loop control.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents the state of a coin toss game, including the player's guess, the coin flip result, and whether the game is over.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Game instance with default initial state.

methods.name: Game.Play
methods.description: Executes a game round by setting the player's guess, performing a coin toss, and marking the game as over.

methods.name: Game.GetResult
methods.description: Returns a message indicating whether the player's guess matched the coin flip result.

methods.name: ValidateGuess
methods.description: Validates that the user's guess is either 'heads' or 'tails'.

methods.name: GetPlayerGuess
methods.description: Prompts the user for their next guess or quit command using the provided prompt interface.

methods.name: PlayGame
methods.description: Handles the main game loop, managing repeated plays based on user guesses and updating streak count.
